tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel. Warm char in dark, paper in light, never blue-black.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, device rows, panels and form sections.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: input wells, ID chips, the device list gutter.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and dialogs that sit above a surface.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy, device names and headings on bg-page, bg-surface and bg-raised.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: host names, descriptions, field help on bg-page and bg-surface.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps and placeholders on bg-page, bg-surface and bg-inset. Light value is one step darker than Matumi's stone-500 so it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Dividers and card edges. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, switches and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on bg-surface, bg-page and bg-raised.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus ring with a 2px offset. Holds 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Canopy green, the brand accent shared with Matumi. Primary buttons, the selected tab, links and the mark. One accent action per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected row and selected segment backgrounds.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent text on accent-subtle and bg-surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: shared
tokens.usage: State: Shared. A device the server offers and nobody is using. Also the live-link dot. Canopy, because Matumi uses canopy for healthy.

tokens.name: shared-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of the Shared badge.

tokens.name: shared-text
tokens.usage: Text on shared-subtle.

tokens.name: attached
tokens.usage: State: Attached. A client is using the device. Matumi's river.

tokens.name: attached-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of the Attached badge.

tokens.name: attached-text
tokens.usage: Text on attached-subtle.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: State: waiting for the server to confirm a change. Always paired with the stripe pattern and a word. As a mark only; text uses pending-text.

tokens.name: pending-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of the Pending badge and pending controls.

tokens.name: pending-text
tokens.usage: Text on pending-subtle.

tokens.name: fault
tokens.usage: State: Offline, rejected change or lost device. Always paired with a word and the fault glyph.

tokens.name: fault-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of the Offline badge and failed controls.

tokens.name: fault-text
tokens.usage: Text on fault-subtle and bg-surface.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Device names on cards, form section headings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Plug a device into this machine to share it.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: VID:PID, bus IDs, host:port, client IDs.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Secondary IDs inside badges and table cells.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control group, badge padding inline.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field label to input, device card row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and form sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop, gap between page regions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, ID chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch track and thumb, live-link dot.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and dialogs only. Cards use a border, not a shadow.
